post_clip.description: At timestamp ~32.0s, a sudden large plume of dark smoke erupts abruptly in the background (mid-left area), consistent with an explosion or rapid fire ignition. The smoke appears instantaneously and expands rapidly, with no visible preceding fire or gradual buildup—matching the expected signature of a sudden blast. No vehicles or people are seen colliding immediately prior, and the event is isolated and abrupt.
